title: Agent Platform SDK reference adapter and contract consumer gate

requirements.statement: Agent Platform SDK reference adapter is registered in the canonical TSIC adapter registry.
SDK cannot grant execution authority, authorize side effects, or replace Platform identity and authorization.
SDK preserves immutable tenant and authenticated-principal metadata.
SDK preserves idempotency metadata required for consequential operations.
SDK preserves trace and correlation context.
SDK CI validates the immutable TSIC adapter contract and required bindings.
